memberdef.name: VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_encrypt

detaileddescription.para: Encrypts plaintext in place and produces a 128-bit authentication tag over the ciphertext and, when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined, over associated_data as well. The operation follows Algorithm 3 of NIST SP 800-232 Section 4.1.1.
On return, the buffer addressed by plaintext holds the ciphertext of equal length. The original plaintext is overwritten and cannot be recovered from plaintext alone.

parameterdescription.para: On entry: plaintext buffer of plaintext_size bytes. On return: ciphertext of equal length, written in place.
Length of plaintext in bytes. May be zero, in which case no plaintext blocks are processed and the tag covers only associated data.
Pointer to associated data of associated_size bytes. Authenticated but not encrypted. Only present when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined.
Length of associated_data in bytes. May be zero. Only present when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined.
128-bit authentication tag produced after finalisation, written as four consecutive 32-bit words.

simplesect.para: key, nonce, plaintext and authentication_tag are non-NULL.
plaintext points to a buffer of at least plaintext_size bytes.
plaintext and authentication_tag do not overlap.
The nonce is used at most once for a given key.

memberdef.argsstring: (const uint32_t key[4U], const uint32_t nonce[4U], uint8_t *ciphertext, const uint32_t ciphertext_size, const uint8_t *associated_data, const uint32_t associated_size, uint32_t authentication_tag[4U])
memberdef.name: VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_decrypt

detaileddescription.para: Decrypts ciphertext in place and verifies the 128-bit authentication tag over the plaintext and, when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined, over associated_data as well. The operation follows Algorithm 4 of NIST SP 800-232 Section 4.1.1.
On return, the buffer addressed by ciphertext holds the plaintext of equal length. The original ciphertext is overwritten and cannot be recovered from ciphertext alone.

parameterdescription.para: On entry: ciphertext buffer of ciphertext_size bytes. On return: plaintext of equal length, written in place.
Length of ciphertext in bytes. May be zero, in which case no ciphertext blocks are processed and the tag covers only associated data.
Pointer to associated data of associated_size bytes. Authenticated but not decrypted. Only present when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined.
Length of associated_data in bytes. May be zero. Only present when VERUM_ASCON_AEAD128_ASSOCIATED_DATA_DEF is defined.
128-bit authentication tag to verify after finalisation, read as four consecutive 32-bit words.

simplesect.para: key, nonce, ciphertext and authentication_tag are non-NULL.
ciphertext points to a buffer of at least ciphertext_size bytes.
ciphertext and authentication_tag do not overlap.
The nonce matches the one used during encryption.
